verdict.rationale: Fern is a hosted docs and SDK platform, so data residency is a fair question, but the pack never documents region selection or residency controls. The only nearby evidence is a passing changelog mention of a self-hosted container resolving environment variables. That is an adjacent deployment detail, not a documented way to choose where data is stored, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
